headline: Sensex rises 333 pts, Nifty above 23,200 snapping 2-day fall
why: Government cut windfall tax on the export of petrol, diesel, and ATF.
Indian markets demonstrated resilience by snapping a two-day losing streak.
US Federal Reserve raised interest rates, signaling further tightening and impacting global markets.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 333 points higher and Nifty closed above the 23,200 level.
US Fed Chair Kevin Warsh signaled potential additional rate hikes in 2026.
Dow Jones dropped 650 points following the hawkish US Fed policy outcome.
Gold prices fell over 1% as the US Dollar and Treasury yields surged.

summary:
Indian benchmark indices snapped a two-day falling streak with Sensex gaining 333 points and Nifty closing above 23,200, aided by windfall tax cuts on fuel exports.
The domestic rally came despite heavy global market selloffs triggered by a US Fed interest rate hike and surging US Treasury yields.
